Welcome to the Connecticut Public Drinking Water Mapping Application


This mapping application is provided by the Connecticut Department of Public Health (CT DPH) to view and analyze spatial information related to public drinking water in Connecticut.

This publicly available data is to be used for informational purposes only. Please contact CT DPH for more information.


https://portal.ct.gov/dph
